question: Which of the following women athletes won three medals, including an individual gold, at the Archery World Cup Stage 2 in Shanghai, China in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhura Dhamangaonkar​.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Madhura Dhamangaonkar won three medals at the Archery World Cup Stage 2 in Shanghai:
 
 
• Individual gold in women’s compound event
 
• Silver in women’s team event
 
• Bronze in mixed team compound event with Abhishek Verma. 
 
 
 
• Her individual gold was a maiden World Cup title, marking a major success in her comeback to international archery. </li
